english: Pay your tab and overdue rent, and I've no complaints.
Best pose as customers and approach the broker.
Then let's split up and look.
Got balls, right? Sell me some.
Come on, give me balls! Balls, I said!
I said I don't have any.
I told you, I don't have any!
I don't! You're creeping me out!
Yeah! That's it!\fTell me what you know.
Don't trade in creepy stuff like that!
Who cares! Gin Tama! GIN TAMA!
What a waste of my time!
Know about shady Gin Tama deals?
You sure I can have it?
Lucky us! Let's keep this up.
Damn. Finding this broker's harder than I thought.
Well, fine, but why here? You don't look too healthy.
Huh? Collapsed? That explains the sickly look.
Hey, don't tell me you broke out again...
And collapsed without a penny to your name?
Oh, crap... I need a time machine to yesterday.
Try using your right brain! Face reality!
Who are you calling a she-gorilla...? I'll kill you.
HEY! You mocking me?!\fIf I had balls, I'd be a MALE gorilla!
You idiot!\fWhat the hell are you thinking?!\fThis old man just collapsed outside our dojo!
A corpse outside the dojo's bad luck, right?
What? Are you saying you won't eat my cooking?
I'm up on the latest trends, you know. I've got balls.
What's wrong, Otae? Quite a racket.
No! Who'd have a name like that?!
Just not a name worth mentioning.\fAnyway, thanks for back then.
Bouncing around in a swimsuit! Bouncing!
Anyway...\fOnce I heard, I couldn't sit still.
What a doting dad... I'm ashamed of myself.
Yeah, luckily, kind Otae saved me.
She's feeding me. Isn't that nice?
Yes! Still got a lot to learn! Sorry!
Oh, right. Had something to ask.\fAbout Gin Tama.
Yeah, well...\fSeems there's a shady broker dealing in Gin Tama.\fKnow anything about it?
A rumor... Could be a lead.
Anyway, didn't you come here for something?
Well... I just collected mine normally.
Isn't this just a fried egg?
Gin Tama? The balls we just used in that match?
A shady broker? Never heard of one.
Oh, come to think of it...
Anyway, seen anyone suspicious around here?
Three guys in black...\fMayo, a gorilla, and a sleep mask?\fNah. Couldn't be.
Nobody's as shady as you... But I saw three guys in black.
I said I'm not a kappa!
I said... I'm NOT a kappa!
I'm no kappa! I'll kill you!
Found you at last!\fDoing shady deals here, huh?
Whoa! That scared me...\fWhat's that voice...?\fUgh! You guys?!
Looks like a kappa, but he's no kappa or monster.
Hey, mayo freak. Your face is twitching.
Oh, scared of kappa and ghosts?
Gee, thanks.\fBut I've never been good at doing as I'm told.
Um, sorry to interrupt...\fCan I go home now?
Don't be stupid. That's a kappa, plain as day.
D-don't be stupid! I'm not scared of that stuff!
Figures.\fOtherwise, you'd have grown into a better adult.
I'll take you on, if you want.
Bring it on! Are we doing this or not?!
Definitely a kappa.\fJust like Grandma said.
Too vicious to let loose, I'm afraid.
I said I'm not a kappa!
You saved me.\fYou're a good guy after all.
That was a Gin Tama too?
Shady types...?\fOh, yeah. Saw some sneaky guys.
